'''Ed Dunn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[April 2001 Findlay tournament]] on 14 April 2001, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2107">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-findlay-ohio-4-14-01d2107/ findlay-ohio-4-14-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 18 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-findlay-ohio-4-14-01d2107/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
